relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: This study provides evidence that morphine, in addition to TLR4 activation, also activates the cGAS-STING pathway.

relationships.subject: TAK242
relationships.evidence_quote: C176 and TAK242 significantly decreased the morphine-induced increased mRNA levels of IL-6 and TNF-α in BV2 and Raw cells

relationships.subject: C176
relationships.evidence_quote: it did inhibit the expression of p-NF-κB, STING and all cytokines in both cells

relationships.subject: mitochondrial DNA
relationships.evidence_quote: mtDNA from morphine-treated cells significantly increased expression of components of the cGAS-STING pathway

relationships.subject: mitochondrial DNA
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that mtDNA promoted polarization of these cells to the M1-like phenotype

key_findings: Morphine increased TLR4, cGAS, STING, p-NF-kB, IL-6 and TNF-alpha in BV2 microglia and Raw macrophages; TLR4 and STING inhibitors reduced cytokine release.
Morphine-induced mtDNA release activates TLR4 and cGAS-STING signaling and M1-like polarization; mtDNA depletion reverses this.
